command.xxsx_mc_smart_core.addmodel.help:
=== API providers ===
Built in: OpenCode Free (no key; tries DeepSeek → GLM → MiMo)
Switch: /ai api <name>  Choose model: /ai model <name>

=== Add a custom API ===
Method 1 (recommended): edit config/xxsx_mc_smart_core-common.toml
Set ai.provider_url / ai.provider_key / ai.provider_model, then rejoin the world.
Method 2: /ai addmodel <URL> <Key> <model> [context length]
Example: /ai addmodel https://api.example.com sk-xxx my-model 70000
Chat has a character limit; use method 1 for long keys.

command.xxsx_mc_smart_core.help:
/ai <message> - talk to AI
/ai build <path> - parse a PMX model
/ai <number> - enter a build multiplier (for example /ai 3; decimals such as 2.5 work)
/ai build y/n - confirm or skip clearing
/ai build speed <N> - set speed
/ai build stop - stop building
/ai api/model - switch model provider or model
/ai addmodel <url> <key> <model> [context length] - add a personal API
/ai flyspeed <number> - set flying speed (default 0.05; 0.1 to 1.0 recommended)
/ai stop - stop the current task
/ai y / confirm - confirm a pending state-changing command
/ai n / cancel - cancel a pending state-changing command
/ai clear - clear the conversation and start over
/ai compact - compact the conversation and retain key context
When context is too long or an action is pending, reply y to confirm or n to cancel.
For integrations, ask the AI to summarize a topic document or query a mod ID.

No built-in command-library entry for: %s
Categories: accessories, Nihility storage, survival status, geology industry, supernatural status, and recipe navigation.
Try [QUERY]commands add curio[/QUERY], [QUERY]commands nihility[/QUERY], or [QUERY]commands earth_human[/QUERY].
General information remains available through [QUERY]integrations %s[/QUERY] or [QUERY]doc %s[/QUERY].

Portable queries: [QUERY]commands add curio[/QUERY], [QUERY]commands nihility[/QUERY], [QUERY]commands earth_human[/QUERY]
Tool rule: queries and commands return [TOOL_RESULT]. Commands that change server state wait for /ai y or /ai confirm; /ai n or /ai cancel declines them.
After a confirmation-required result, the model must wait for the player's choice instead of repeating the same [CMD].
Model rule: output [CMD] only when the player explicitly asks to perform the action. After a confirmation-required result, wait for /ai y or /ai confirm.
